violations.text: An allergen statement is lacking on menu boards and/or point of sale. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. PIC provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

Milk was observed held at 50 degrees Fahrenheit in an open-air unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Inspector observed containers of milk and other beverages were blocking the vents; containers were moved to facilitate air flow. PIC moved extra bottles to alternate refrigeration. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

Yogurt, parfaits, and salads packaged in the food establishment are lacking complete labels; sub ingredients are missing. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients (including sub ingredients), the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Label guidance was provided. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/10/2025
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/27/2025

Parfaits packaged in the food establishment are complete lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 02/10/2025

Working containers of various sauces are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 02/10/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and microwaves have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 02/10/2025
